mentions.name: VibeProlog
mentions.description: A Prolog project built with heavy use of free LLM models; it is in pretty good shape now, and the next step is rebuilding the parser so it can load libraries in a more reasonable way.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've spent a lot of time with free models because I use them heavily in my VibeProlog project (https://github.com/nlothian/Vibe-Prolog/),  which is actually in pretty good shape now. Next step is to rebuild the parser so it can load libraries in a somewhat reasonable way.
